decision_rule.confirmed: SEED_REPLICATION_CONFIRMED iff seed-3102 PACT minus ACT is positive and >= +0.10, and PACT minus PACT_PERMUTED is positive on both seeds
decision_rule.failed: SEED_REPLICATION_FAILED iff seed-3102 PACT minus ACT is < +0.10
decision_rule.incomplete: SEED_REPLICATION_INCOMPLETE iff the frozen 240-cell two-seed matrix does not reconcile
decision_rule.partial: SEED_REPLICATION_PARTIAL iff seed-3102 PACT minus ACT is positive and >= +0.10, but PACT minus PACT_PERMUTED is <= 0 on either seed

primary_endpoint: task_success and hazard_bar contacts == 0 and other_environment contacts == 0
